ALPHABET CENTER · LETTER H

Letter H — House.

A sturdy blue house with a chimney, for the letter H. H is a breath of a letter — you cannot see it, but you can feel it on your hand.

Meet the letter, hear its sound, trace it together — then play. Everything on this page is free, gentle and paced for you.

THE LETTER SOUND

What does H say?

“h — hhh, a soft breath”

H says hhh — just a breath, like warming your hands or giggling quietly. Hold your palm in front of your mouth: if you feel air, the sound is there.

TRACE THE LETTER

Trace H h together.

Follow the numbers with a finger — on screen or on each other’s palms. The arrows show the way to go, the numbers show where to start, and a grown-up reads the little script below each card. Slow and wobbly is exactly right.

Trace the uppercase H

Start at 1 at the top left, pull straight down. Lift. Start at 2 at the top right, pull straight down. Lift. Pull straight across the middle.

Trace the lowercase h

Start at 1 at the top, pull straight down. Lift. Start at 2 on the stem, arch up over to the right and pull straight down.

TAKE IT OFF SCREEN

House hunt.

Two minutes is plenty. Follow your child’s lead and stop while it is still fun — that is the whole method.

  1. 01

    Walk through your home finding things that start with hhh: house, hat, hand, hair.

  2. 02

    Knock on three doors in your home and say hhh, hello!

  3. 03

    Draw your house together and put a big H on the door.

PLAY & PRACTICE

Games that use this letter.

The games mix every letter — play them after meeting two or three letters, or any day your child asks. No scores, no timers, no wrong answers that count.
